Veo is paid-only, so your free-tier account can’t run this request as specified. I haven’t started a generation or spent any credits.

Also, the available Veo model here is **Veo 3.1**, which doesn’t support an exact 5-second duration—it supports 4, 6, or 8 seconds for short clips.

Would you like to upgrade and revise the request to **6 seconds using Veo 3.1**, or leave it ungenerated? I won’t substitute another model or spend credits without your approval.
